CHAPTER 2 · ITEM 03 / 12

Economic thinking and models

Why economists disagree經濟學家為何分歧

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Explain why economists may disagree about evidence, model assumptions, parameter estimates or values.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

分歧可來自理論、假設、估計參數或價值觀。即使同意政策效果，也可能因對平等或效率的重視不同而不同意政策。

Economists can disagree about causal theories, assumptions, estimated responses or social values. Agreement on an effect does not guarantee agreement on whether a policy is desirable.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Two economists agree a tax raises revenue, but disagree on how much labor supply falls and how important redistribution is. 對反應大小和分配價值均可有分歧。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Both agree on a policy's effects but prefer different outcomes. Main source of disagreement? 效果相同、偏好結果不同，分歧主要來自？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
